# Project: SI Helper

## General

- This is a learning project. Explain important architectural decisions.
- Prefer simple, readable code over clever abstractions.
- Use TypeScript and Angular.
- Use 4 spaces for indentation.
- Keep components modular and reusable.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.

## Development

- Follow modern Angular conventions.
- Use strict TypeScript typing.
- Keep business logic separate from UI components.
- Write tests for important functionality.
- Run the build after significant changes.
- Fix errors before considering a task complete.

## Working with the user

- Be proactive and suggest improvements.
- When implementing a feature, handle all necessary files.
- Don't just provide code snippets: actually implement changes.
- Inspect existing code before modifying it.
- Explain what was created and where.
- Ask before introducing major architectural changes.
- Don't overwrite existing functionality without checking first.
